newsitem.title: USA: Lilly shares seen in likely split range.
newsitem.headline: Lilly shares seen in likely split range.

text.p: Shares in Eli Lilly and Co, trading up 2 at 108 in early Tuesday action on the New York Stock Exchange, are in a price range where a two-for-one split appears likely, said drug industry analysts.

"That's what typically happens with these multinational pharmaceutical companies. They get into that $100 area and they split two-for-one ... That will probably happen," said Principal Financial analyst Eugene Melnitchenko.
A spokesman for the Indianapolis-based drug manufacturer declined to comment.
The company last announced a split on October 17, 1995, when the stock closed at 93-3/4. The stock rose to 99-1/2 before the split took effect on November 15 of that year.
The last split before the one in 1995 occurred on March 31, 1989, when the stock closed at 102-7/8.
